Class TurDslToolService

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.tool.TurDslToolService
@Service public class TurDslToolService extends Object
Elasticsearch-compatible DSL Tool Calling service for Semantic Navigation.

Mirrors the tools from the official Elasticsearch MCP Server, adapted for Turing ES multi-engine architecture (Solr, Lucene, Elasticsearch).

Tools:

  • dsl_list_indices — list available SN sites (equivalent to ES indices)
  • dsl_get_mappings — get field mappings for a site
  • dsl_search — execute a full Elasticsearch Query DSL search
  • dsl_get_document — retrieve a document by ID
  • dsl_suggest — autocomplete and spell-check suggestions
